rules: Pupils are tapered vertical slits, about a third of the iris wide at the middle, never a constant-width bar.
Standing still the neck is upright and the head sits over the forechest; walking, the head drops to about the back's level.

Name the type before building: the modern Siamese (show: wedge head, big low ears, tubular body, long fine legs) and the traditional colourpoint (rounder head with full cheeks, medium ears, a sturdier body) share colours but not shapes; a colour profile never sets the body.

The head must read as a cat at a glance: a short muzzle with a stop, cheekbones widest at the eyes, whisker pads, a chin, forward eyes on a flat face, wide-based ears (lowpoly-animals/references/heads.md, A cat's head).
The neck pinches in behind the skull from above and runs into the head without a crease.
